images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: The Candlewick was sixty hours out with eleven thousand doses of fever medicine, and the channel into Marrowgate gave her six point three metres of water against a draft of seven point one.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Candlewick je bila oddaljena šestdeset ur in je prevažala enajst tisoč odmerkov zdravila proti mrzlici, kanal v Marrowgate pa ji je ponujal šest celih tri metre vode pri ugrezu…
